title: Fernández-Díaz 2011 · Rear parallelity and mirror matching
citation: Fernández-Díaz and Travieso (2011). Performance in haptic geometrical matching tasks depends on movement and position of the arms. Acta Psychologica, 136(3), 382–389.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

published_method.coordinate_frame: Lateral relative to table midline and depth from near edge, in cm.
published_method.bar_setup: 20 cm pivoted bar with 1.1 cm diameter and arrow-shaped ends on a magnetized steel table.
published_method.posture: Blindfolded, standing with back to table.

factors.paired_test_positions: Contralateral, two positions for parallel and inner position for mirror

published_method.blocks: Counterbalance the two task blocks and randomize trials within them. 16 parallel and eight mirror trials.
published_method.task: Rotate the test bar to be parallel to the reference or its mirror image. For parallel trials also identify which ends point in the same direction.
published_method.outcome: Signed angular error. Reverse right-hand reference signs for the rear analysis.
published_method.source_discrepancy: Figure 5 panel label calls the mirror task frontal. Methods and figure caption locate it in rear space.
